analogy.rationale: EHMT1/2 inhibition alters chromatin methylation and can overlap transcriptionally with other epigenetic modifiers such as DNMT and HDAC inhibitors, but the response is typically modest in these cell lines; CDK2/4 activity is only indirectly affected, so kinase inhibitors are less similar.
